Police officers from the Judea and Samaria District launched an investigation following reports of an arson incident in the village of Burqa and a confrontation in the village of Ein Yabrud in the Binyamin region.

Police officers and forensic investigators entered Burqa accompanied by IDF forces, collected findings and evidence, and took witness statements.

Police stated that the investigation is ongoing and that forces are also expected to enter the scene in Ein Yabrud.

flash_695707.description:
Detectives from the Western Galilee Police Station and Border Police officers from the Coastal District raided a compound in the village of Yarka, uncovering commercial quantities of substances suspected to be drugs, including approximately 8 kilograms of hashish and 1,000 Captagon pills, known as the "courage drug," which have also been used by Hamas and ISIS terrorists. The drugs were allegedly intended for distribution.

During the raid, officers also seized communications devices and a digital surveillance system, which are suspected of having been intended for monitoring and surveillance for criminal purposes. Two local residents were arrested and taken to the Western Galilee Police Station for further questioning.

Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) issued a new threat, suggesting it could target undersea communications infrastructure in the Strait of Hormuz.

flash_695727.description:
A new mediation proposal reportedly calls for the release of $6 billion in frozen Iranian funds in exchange for Iran allowing International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) inspectors to visit its nuclear sites.

According to the Qatari-based Al-Araby Al-Jadeed news outlet, Qatar and Pakistan are behind the proposal, which would release $6 billion in interest accrued on Iranian funds frozen in Qatari banks in return for a covert visit by IAEA inspectors to Iran’s nuclear facilities.

The report says the proposal has received US approval and preliminary Iranian agreement. However, no official confirmation of an agreement has been issued.

flash_695789.description:
The IDF clarified Wednesday that the olive harvest near Beitar Illit in Judea, during which New York congressional candidate Brad Lander and dozens of other activists were detained, was unauthorized. According to the military, harvesting in the area requires advance coordination with Israeli authorities to ensure security and maintain public order. The participants failed to obtain the required authorization, prompting IDF soldiers, Border Police forces, and police officers to intervene.

The military emphasized that approximately 100 coordinated olive harvests have already taken place across Judea and Samaria this season, producing dozens of tons of olives without unusual incidents. The landowner was provided with contact information to arrange a future harvest, while the IDF reiterated that only authorized harvesters may enter designated agricultural areas.

The IDF confirmed that it struck in the Daraj Tuffah area on Monday and eliminated the terrorist Abdullah Munir Mahmoud Harz, a deputy platoon commander in the rocket array of the Islamic Jihad terrorist organization. The terrorist advanced sniper attacks against IDF troops.

In a separate strike on Monday in the Gaza City area, the IDF eliminated the terrorist Muhammad Wael Mustafa Sha'sha'a, a sniper operative in the Daraj Tuffah Battalion of the Hamas terrorist organization's military wing.

Throughout the war, and particularly in recent weeks, the terrorists advanced terror attacks against IDF troops and Israeli civilians and operated to restore the organizations’ military capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire. The terrorists were eliminated to remove the threat.

flash_695800.description:
New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani commented on the detention of Democratic congressional candidate Brad Lander during an unauthorized Palestinian Arab olive harvest near the Jewish town of Beitar Illit.

"Today, Brad Lander, rabbis, and other New Yorkers accompanied Palestinian farmers during the olive harvest. For that, they were detained by the Israeli government. Harvesting olives is not illegal. The occupation is," Mamdani wrote.

He stated that he was thankful that Lander was released, but claimed that "other New Yorkers remain detained, and they must be released immediately."

According to Mamdani, "The same Israeli government detaining them has committed a horrific genocide against Palestinians, killing more than 74,000 people over the last few years alone. The detention of these New Yorkers must end. The occupation must end. The genocide must end."

According to the official, pressure is mounting among segments of the Iranian public to take decisive action to lift the American naval blockade, citing the right to self-defense.

The official added that Iran has issued instructions to its operational commanders stating that, in the event of another full-scale war involving the assassination of senior officials and attacks on civilians, it would consider American political targets, targets associated with parties participating in the fighting, and their infrastructure legitimate targets for attack. According to the official, the list of targets has already been prepared.

flash_695875.description: Religious Zionist MK Ohad Tal calls for Jewish communities in Gaza, warning that Israel cannot afford to leave its enemies without consequences.

flash_695874.description: Tehran’s nuclear activities and military network are Israeli security concerns regardless of who occupies the White House. Opinion.

flash_695873.description: President Trump accuses Tehran of fabricating attacks in the Strait of Hormuz, condemns the killing of Iranian protesters, and vows that Iran will never obtain nuclear weapons.

flash_695872.description: Zionism knew how to move from dream to action, from exile to return, and from settlement to the establishment of the state. Now it is time for sovereignty over all parts of that state. Opinion.

flash_695871.description: National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir has informed Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara that he will continue attending demolitions of illegal structures in the Negev.

flash_695870.description: A magnitude 7 earthquake struck the Nagchu region of Tibet, the German Geological Survey (GFZ) reported. The epicenter was about 10 kilometers below the surface, according to the report. There were no immediate reports of casualties or damage.

flash_695869.description:
Following the report of a shooting in the area of Homesh, an initial inquiry indicates that an Israeli civilian identified a suspected armed individual and heard gunfire that was not related to a terror attack. Furthermore, the civilian fired toward the source of the gunfire.

IDF soldiers were dispatched to the scene and are conducting searches for armed individuals in the area.

flash_695868.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz approved sanctions against Coral Oil after Israeli authorities found that the company supplied diesel and gasoline to a Hezbollah-owned fuel distributor.

flash_695867.description: Following reports of a shooting in the Homesh area of ​​Samaria, there are no reports of casualties at this stage. IDF forces were called to the scene and the circumstances of the incident are being investigated.

flash_695866.description: Initial report - A report was received regarding a shooting in the area of Homesh. IDF soldiers were dispatched to the scene.

flash_695865.description: Magen David Adom and IDF medical teams are performing resuscitation efforts on a girl approximately 12 years old who was injured while riding a bicycle in the community of Yitzhar in Samaria.

flash_695864.description: Amichai Attali criticized Deri's "Tefillin for Every Child" program, claiming that its real purpose is to create jobs for political associates.

flash_695855.description: Israel Aerospace Industries begins converting Boeing 777 passenger jets into cargo aircraft at a new Arizona facility, expanding its global operations and creating hundreds of American jobs.

flash_695853.description: Prime Minister Netanyahu rejects a Financial Times report claiming President Trump prevented Israel from launching a major attack against Iran earlier this month.

flash_695851.description: Former Edmonton journalist admits to vandalizing monuments of Ukrainian Nazi collaborators.
